films.desc_en: A premium and intense gym commercial following a woman's strength training session with a clear progression from struggle to triumph.
films.music: Driving electronic bass, intense and motivational, 120 bpm
vo_mk: Секое утро е нова борба со себе.
Но ти знаеш зошто си тука.
Силата се гради со секое повторување.
Почувствувај ја енергијата во твоето тело.

shots.kf: Close-up of a 30-year-old woman with dark hair in a tight ponytail, wearing a sleek black sports top, looking determined in a dimly lit premium gym. Cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, cool blue and warm amber tones, photorealistic.
shots.motion: She breathes in deeply, her shoulders rising slightly. Slow push-in camera move.

shots.kf: Medium shot. The same 30-year-old woman with dark hair in a tight ponytail and black sports top is lifting a black kettlebell. Background shows blurred modern gym equipment. Warm spotlights, high contrast, photorealistic.
shots.motion: She swings the kettlebell upward in a smooth, continuous motion. Slow camera pan to the right.

shots.kf: Wide shot. The same 30-year-old woman in a black sports top and charcoal leggings performs a slow lunge on a wooden gym floor. Large windows reveal a blurred Skopje cityscape. Natural daylight mixing with interior warm lights, photorealistic.
shots.motion: She lowers her body smoothly into the lunge. Slow camera track backward.

shots.kf: Close-up on the woman's face, same dark hair in a tight ponytail. She is sweating slightly but smiling with satisfaction. Soft, diffused lighting highlighting the texture of her skin. Neutral dark background, photorealistic.
shots.motion: She wipes a drop of sweat from her forehead with her wrist. Slow camera dolly in.

shots.kf: Wide shot from behind. The same woman stands tall, hands on her hips, looking out of a large gym window at the silhouette of Mount Vodno at sunset. Golden hour lighting, warm orange and deep shadow palette, photorealistic.
shots.motion: She stands still, breathing steadily. The camera slowly rises up.

films.desc_en: An atmospheric dawn running commercial tracking a male runner's journey along the Vardar river.
films.music: Uplifting synthwave, steady rhythmic pulse, 110 bpm
vo_mk: Градот уште спие, но ти не.
Диши длабоко и уживај во слободата.

shots.kf: Extreme close-up of a 25-year-old man with short brown hair tying the laces of a modern running shoe. He wears a bright neon-yellow running jacket. Paving stones of the Vardar quay in the background. Cool dawn light, photorealistic.
shots.motion: His hands pull the laces tight in a simple motion. Slow tilt up of the camera.

shots.kf: Medium shot from the side. The same 25-year-old man in the neon-yellow jacket is jogging along the concrete path next to the Vardar river. Early morning mist, soft blue and grey tones. Shallow depth of field, photorealistic.
shots.motion: He jogs forward with a steady, rhythmic pace. Camera tracks alongside him.

shots.kf: Wide shot. The same man in the neon-yellow jacket and dark shorts sprints across a footbridge over the river. The architecture of Skopje is blurred in the background. Bright morning light breaking through clouds, photorealistic.
shots.motion: He sprints powerfully across the frame. Slow camera pan following his movement.

shots.kf: Medium close-up. The same 25-year-old man in the neon-yellow jacket slows down to a walk, breathing heavily but looking relaxed. The morning sun illuminates his face. Warm, natural lighting, photorealistic.
shots.motion: He exhales deeply and rolls his shoulders back. Slow camera push in.

shots.kf: Wide shot. Silhouette of the same man standing near the edge of the Vardar river, looking at the sunrise. Brilliant orange and pink sky reflecting on the water. Cinematic, high contrast, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Gentle ripples on the water surface, the man stands still. Slow camera zoom out.

films.desc_en: A fast-paced, high-energy vertical reel showcasing kids playing football to drive academy sign-ups.
films.music: Upbeat dynamic hip-hop beat, energetic, 130 bpm
vo_mk: Време е за фудбал! Придружи ни се!

shots.kf: Vertical portrait. Close-up of a classic black and white football resting on vibrant green artificial turf. A child's foot in a bright red football boot is poised right next to it. Bright, sunny daylight, high saturation, sharp focus, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The red boot firmly kicks the ball forward out of frame. Fast camera push in.

shots.kf: Vertical portrait. Low angle shot of a 10-year-old boy with curly hair in an unbranded blue sports jersey, mid-air, attempting a header. Clear blue sky background. Dynamic composition, frozen action feel, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The boy's head moves forward in a heading motion. Camera tilts up quickly.

shots.kf: Vertical portrait. Medium shot of a football hitting the back of a white goal net. The net bulges outward. Blurred green field in the background. High contrast, bright sunny lighting, realistic physics, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The net stretches backward dynamically as the ball strikes it. Slow camera pan right.

films.desc_en: A sleek, technical explainer film highlighting a modern massage gun for athletic recovery.
films.music: Minimalist electronic ambient, clean and precise, 100 bpm
vo_mk: Запознајте ја новата технологија за брзо мускулно закрепнување.
Нашиот уред користи длабоки вибрации за опуштање на ткивото.
Ја подобрува циркулацијата и ја намалува болката по тренинг.
Идеален за професионални спортисти и рекреативци во секое време.

shots.kf: Close-up of a sleek, unbranded matte-black massage gun resting on a wooden bench in a modern locker room. Soft overhead lighting, premium aesthetic, shallow depth of field. Monochromatic palette with warm wood tones, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow, smooth camera pan across the surface of the device.

shots.kf: Medium shot. An athletic man's muscular thigh. The matte-black massage gun is pressed against the muscle. Minimalist gym background. Studio lighting highlighting the muscle definition and the device's sleek design, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The massage gun head pulses rapidly against the muscle. Camera slowly dollies in.

shots.kf: Extreme close-up of the massage gun's glowing LED interface, displaying simple geometric power levels in soft blue light. Dark background, highly detailed macro photography, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The LED lights slowly pulse and glow brighter. Slow camera tilt down.

shots.kf: Medium shot. A woman sitting on a yoga mat, using the black massage gun on her calf. She looks relaxed. Bright, airy room with large windows and white walls. Natural daylight, photorealistic.
shots.motion: She slowly glides the device up and down her leg. Slow camera track left.

shots.kf: Close-up of a different attachment head of the massage gun, a smooth spherical shape, resting on a clean white towel. Soft, diffused lighting, clean and clinical aesthetic, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow camera rotation around the spherical attachment.

shots.kf: Wide shot. A sports bag on a bench, the massage gun is neatly placed inside among folded towels and a water bottle. High-end fitness club environment. Warm ambient lighting, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow camera pull back revealing the locker room environment.

shots.kf: Close-up. The matte-black massage gun standing upright on a sleek display pedestal. Dramatic studio lighting, dark background, cinematic shadows. Premium product shot, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow camera pedestal up, keeping the device centered.

films.desc_en: An emotional and poetic homage to team sports, focusing on the intimate bonds and dedication found in a local basketball club.
films.music: Uplifting ambient orchestral, slow build, emotional, 90 bpm
vo_mk: Повеќе од игра. Ова е наше семејство.
Заедно паѓаме, заедно се креваме кон врвот.
Едно срце, еден тим, една заедничка победа.

shots.kf: Wide shot. An empty, old wooden basketball court in Skopje, illuminated by a single shaft of dusty morning sunlight coming through a high window. Moody, cinematic lighting, rich brown and amber tones, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Dust motes dance in the light shaft. Slow camera push in towards the center of the court.

shots.kf: Close-up. Two hands holding a worn, orange leather basketball. The hands are wrapped in white athletic tape. Dark background, strong rim lighting highlighting the texture of the leather and skin, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The hands slowly rotate the basketball. Slow camera tilt up.

shots.kf: Medium shot. A coach, a 50-year-old man with grey hair, gently placing his hand on the shoulder of a young athlete. The athlete is looking down, then looks up. Soft, warm lighting, emotional and intimate, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The coach nods slowly and gives a reassuring pat. Slow camera dolly in.

shots.kf: Wide shot. Five unbranded basketball jerseys hanging in a row in a dimly lit locker room. The team colors are dark red and gold. Cinematic shadows, moody atmosphere, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The jerseys sway very slightly in a gentle breeze. Slow camera track right.

shots.kf: Medium shot. Silhouettes of three basketball players standing together in a huddle, arms around each other's shoulders. Bright, diffused light coming from the gym entrance behind them. High contrast, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The players lean in closer together. Slow camera zoom out.

shots.kf: Wide shot. A basketball flying through the air towards a hoop in slow motion. The background is a soft, out-of-focus gymnasium ceiling. Bright, airy lighting, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The ball gracefully arcs through the frame and drops through the net. Slow camera pan following the ball.
